extractor-severe-cycle-v1.notes: Matte repaired; front and rear poses remain too similar, drill phases are subtle, and chassis/scale drift needs correction. Severe damage reads weakly. Not port registered.

assembler-light-cycle-v1.notes: Matte repaired, but the first row still rotates the hopper/chassis across columns. Reject that row for playback; four stable directions and anchors are required.

assembler-severe-cycle-v1.notes: Matte repaired and damage visible, but first-row hopper direction changes and frame scale/base positions drift. Rebuild fixed-view sequences before world use.

generator-cycle-v1.notes: Recovered correction removes checkerboard. Fan motion is subtle; measure foundation/port drift and verify running/off distinction before world use.

sentry-fire-v1.notes: Matte repaired. Four aim views and barrel recoil are visible; validate fixed base/port alignment and shot-event timing before world use.

transport-items-v1.notes: Recovered matte correction has four distinct ore/assembly/crystal/scrap silhouettes. Requires individual crop/scale and compositing review on terrain before transport integration.

guardian-idle-v1.notes: Matte repaired. Four same-view breathing poses preserve rock-armored identity; measure ground-contact drift before world use.

guardian-collapse-v1.notes: Matte repaired. Clear four-stage collapse ends in rubble; register fixed ground position and persist terminal remains before world use.

crawler-attack-v1.notes: Matte repaired and strike poses visible, but front-row strike reverses facing and shifts body center. Correct fixed camera/facing and ground anchors before world use.

crawler-death-v1.notes: Matte repaired; terminal collapsed poses read clearly. First two direction rows are near duplicates rather than true quarter-turn views; register consistent body scale and contacts before world use.
